summary: Operator site read in a browser (Cloudflare blocks curl): A sites 30 A full hookups C$50, B C$45, C (no services) C$25, group C$100; weekly C$300 / monthly C$800; online booking per site; 47 mapped sites (32 A, 2 B, 10 C, 3 group); Google 4.3/72; electric 30 added; not waterfront confirmed; pin within ~150 m.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: price C$50 a night for a full-hookup A site (C$45 B, C$25 unserviced C) on the operator's live page (read 2026-11-11) - under C$69. Presence: working website (Cloudflare blocks curl; loads in a browser) with phone 604-306-9704; Google Maps 'Peace River Adventures Campground & Tours' 4.3 from 72 reviews, phone +1 604-306-9704, open. RV Life: stored rating none, not looked up further. Passes.

LONG-STAY TESTS: weekly (C$300), monthly (C$800) and 'Seasonal bookings' are marketed beside the nightly rates. (1) nights for sale: every one of the 34 A/B RV sites has its own nightly price and an online 'Check availability and reserve this campsite' link - no application or lease; (2) nightly rate posted - yes; (3) no standing minimum stated (only 'Maximum stay for tenting guests is 5 days'); (4) share sold nightly: all mapped RV sites are offered nightly online; I could NOT run a one-night occupancy check (the per-site reserve widget is a WooCommerce form that did not render a calendar in the headless browser, and the campground is out of season) - UNREAD; (5) not a home community. Read as an ordinary nightly campground with long-stay options, not mostly seasonal.

FIT: no site lengths are posted anywhere. Whether the C$25 C sites (no services) are meant for RVs is not stated; the rules say 'Maximum stay for tenting guests is 5 days' and treat tents separately. If AWH reads C sites as tent sites, the base is C$45 (B) / C$50 (A).
D SITES: the rate card lists 'D Sites Shared Power: 30/30A Sewer: No $40 / night', but no D site appears among the 47 mapped/bookable sites - not used for the fees range.

PHONE 604-306-9704 (a BC area code) confirmed on the operator page and Google. Website https://peaceriveradventures.ca answers 403 to curl (Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked'), 200 in a browser, and is this campground. Wayback capture 2026-06-16 exists (429 to curl today).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the loop sits in a clearing west of a rail line; the Peace River is ~300 m east across the tracks, a road and a treed bank (imagery).
PIN (56.2348,-117.3138): at the west end of the loop; the centroid of the operator's 47 site points is 56.23439,-117.31147 (~150 m). Within tolerance.
SEASON: not stated on any page read; left unset. Ownership private (operator Peace River Adventures; the page credits 'The Town of Peace River Tourism Enhancement Grant'); land owner not stated.
